title: CANARY ENGINEERING validation record
description: One frozen ENGINEERING deterministic validation check (SPEC.md Section 8 'ENGINEERING validation record'). It never carries an official model estimate, experiment_id, empirical analysis role, or official denominator. passed is Boolean or null only when evidence is incomplete. Pre-lock version: additive changes land with fixtures and tests.

validation_record_id.description: Deterministic: validation_id plus the unique check_id. Globally unique within the bundle.

input.description: The input fixture or mock scenario the check ran on.

passed.description: Boolean, or null only when evidence is incomplete. Never coerce unknown to false.

hashes.description: Code/container, validation-plan, fixture, schema, oracle/scorer, prompt, defense/prototype, and report-generator hashes applicable to the check.

reason_codes.description: Failure or indeterminate reason codes; empty when passed is true.

official_empirical_record.description: Always false: an ENGINEERING record is never an official empirical record.

not.description: An ENGINEERING validation record must not carry empirical identifiers or official analysis roles.
